scene: Mid-air, you grab the disco drone as it swings you toward a sky-bridge.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view high above rooftops. The player in red bomber jacket and white roller skates dangles centre from a glittering disco-ball drone hovering up high. On the far left, a slanting glowing cable descends. To the right along the lower level stretches an illuminated, transparent glass sky-bridge walkway.
shown: a glass sky-bridge walkway stretching across the ground line on the right
the whirring mirrored drone directly overhead, clutching its dangling silver harness
a glowing neon power cable slanting downward to the far left

variants.scene: Your skates dangle high above the rooftops as the glittering disco drone carries you.
Cool evening air rushes past while you cling to the sparkling flying ball.
Sparkles dance across the brick skyline as you swing above the busy glass corridor.
